welcome.lede: Assign them work like you'd assign a colleague — they pick it up, update status, and comment when done.
welcome.lede_web: Desktop bundles the runtime — nothing to install. Continue on web to connect your own CLI.
welcome.lede_desktop: Connect a runtime and create your first project. 小阿孚 is available when you need help.
welcome.illustration_caption: From requirements to release, agents hand off the work. You approve the key decisions.
welcome.illustration_title: One task, from request to release
welcome.illustration_context: An example shown in order. After fixes and a successful re-review, you decide whether to release.

illustration.card1_body: Move permissions to resource-level authorization. Define the requirements first, and preserve access for all 5 existing roles.
illustration.card2_body_prefix: Requirements and 200 acceptance cases are ready.
illustration.card2_body_suffix: , please confirm: authorization logic only this release, with no admin UI changes.
illustration.card3_body: Following your approved scope: resource, action, condition triples. Migration is planned, with all 5 existing roles supported.
illustration.card4_body: All 37 endpoints now use unified authorization. PR submitted; security review and regression tests must pass before merging.
illustration.card5_body_prefix: Found 2 privilege-escalation risks in bulk endpoints. Merge is blocked.
illustration.card5_body_suffix: , fix these and submit for another review.
illustration.card6_body_prefix: All 200 cases pass after the fixes, and security re-review passed too.
illustration.card6_body_suffix: , please accept the changes and approve release.

source_backfill.lede: One quick question — it helps us understand who finds Multica useful. Answer once and you're back to your work.
source_backfill.hint_ready: Looks good. Hit Submit when you're ready.

about_you.question: From SDLC to ADLC. Build with agents.
about_you.description: You set the direction and make the key decisions. Agents collaborate from requirements to delivery.

source.question: How did you hear about Multica?
source.other_placeholder: e.g. a podcast I listen to

role.question: What's your role in the development process?

step_question.hint_pick: Pick one to continue — or skip if you'd rather not say.
step_question.hint_continue: Looks good. Hit Continue when you're ready.

cli_install.intro: You'll need an agent runtime on this computer (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, …) for it to run your agent. Also works on servers and remote dev boxes.

cloud_waitlist.intro_main: Cloud runtimes aren't live yet. Leave your email and we'll reach out when they are.
cloud_waitlist.intro_warning: Heads-up: agents can't execute tasks without a runtime — if you hit Skip now, nothing will run until you come back and install one.
cloud_waitlist.reason_placeholder: e.g. we want agents running 24/7, or my team works across different devices.
cloud_waitlist.success_toast: You're on the list. We'll email when cloud runtimes are live.

skip.title: Welcome to Multica!
skip.subtitle: We've added one issue to help you connect a runtime. When it's ready, start with 小阿孚 from Runtimes.
skip.error_body: The runtime guide didn't get created. You can try again, or connect a runtime from the Runtimes page whenever you're ready.

install_runtime.title: Connect a runtime
install_runtime.subtitle: Install Codex or Kimi, then start the guided 小阿孚 chat from Runtimes.

step_workspace.lede_first: A workspace is where your issues, agents, and projects live. You can invite teammates or spin up more workspaces later.
step_workspace.lede_resume: Resume setup with the workspace you already have, or create a new one alongside it — you can belong to any number of workspaces.
step_workspace.name_placeholder: Acme Inc, My Lab, Side Projects…
step_workspace.issue_prefix_suffix: . You can change this later in settings.
step_workspace.issue_prefix_pending: Set the URL above and issue numbers will follow it — or type a prefix here.
step_workspace.create_new_subtitle: Start fresh — a separate space for a different side of your work.
step_workspace.hint_name_first: Name your workspace to create it.
step_workspace.hint_pick: Pick your workspace or start a new one.
step_workspace.slug_format_error: Only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens
step_workspace.slug_taken_error: That workspace URL is already taken.
step_workspace.slug_reserved_error: That workspace URL is reserved and cannot be used.
step_workspace.creation_disabled_headline: Ask your administrator for an invitation.
step_workspace.creation_disabled_lede: This Multica instance does not allow new workspaces to be created. Once an administrator invites you to a workspace, accept the invitation and refresh to continue.
step_workspace.creation_disabled_lede_resume: Workspace creation is disabled on this instance, so you'll continue into your existing workspace.

step_runtime.scanning_lede_prefix: Your agent works through an AI coding tool you already have — like
step_runtime.scanning_lede_suffix: , and others. We're checking this computer for ones you've installed.
step_runtime.found_lede: These are the agent runtimes we found on this computer. You can switch it or add more later.
step_runtime.empty_headline: No agent runtime found on this computer yet.
step_runtime.empty_lede_prefix: An agent runtime is an AI coding tool we connect to — like
step_runtime.empty_lede_suffix: . Install one and refresh, or skip for now.
step_runtime.empty_skip_subtitle: Enter your workspace now. Your agent can't run tasks until an agent runtime is connected on this computer — but you can still browse, plan, and invite teammates.
step_runtime.hint_pick: Pick a runtime, then create your first project.
step_runtime.hint_skip_or_refresh: Refresh after installing one, or skip to enter your workspace.

step_platform.headline: Connect a computer to run your agent.
step_platform.lede: 小阿孚, your workspace's Chief of Staff, runs on a real computer that you connect to Multica. Pick how you want to connect one.
step_platform.hint_default: Pick a way to connect — or skip and connect a computer later.
step_platform.download_subtitle: Install our desktop app to connect this computer. Opens in a new tab — pick your platform there.
step_platform.cli_subtitle: Connect a server, remote dev box, or any headless computer. Terminal required.
step_platform.cli_dialog_description: Same connection as Desktop, set up from the terminal. Use it for servers, remote dev boxes, or any headless computer.
step_platform.stage_normal_prefix: Run the command above. As soon as
step_platform.stage_normal_suffix: finishes browser sign-in, your computer will appear here automatically (usually 10–30 seconds).
step_platform.stage_midway_prefix: Still listening. Make sure you finished the browser tab that
step_platform.stage_midway_suffix: opened — it needs you to approve sign-in before your computer can connect.
step_platform.stage_slow_prefix: Taking longer than usual. Check the terminal where you ran
step_platform.stage_stalled_prefix: Nothing coming through yet. If you're not comfortable with the terminal,
step_platform.stage_stalled_suffix: is the smoother path — one click and this computer is connected. Close this dialog and pick Desktop, or hit Skip to continue.

mika_intro.headline: Meet 小阿孚, your first agent teammate.
mika_intro.name: 小阿孚
mika_intro.blurb: Tell 小阿孚 what you want done. It becomes an issue, with the right agent on it.
